prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 7 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1107; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes. The reported mechanism is consistent with the shoulder injury described, and the force involved appears to match the pattern of soft tissue and joint findings documented on examination. Over seven visits, the patient received conservative management including manual therapy, graded range-of-motion exercises, and a home program. Treatment extended somewhat beyond the course typically seen for this type of injury, reflecting a slower functional recovery. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the injury. The patient also has a history of treatment to the same shoulder region within the past two years, and that prior condition appears to contribute to some of the current complaints. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no repeated charges for the same services.
